title: Leon Wankum: The Insane Math Behind Bitcoin Demonetizing Real Estate
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Leon Wankum: The Insane Math Behind Bitcoin Demonetizing Real Estate Leon Wankum argues real estate's $300T+ monetary premium is migrating to Bitcoin, projecting a $1M target and explaining why it's smarter to rent and buy BTC.
